body:
Tested locally, it works as expected. Code looks good to me.

## Benchmark

<details open>

<summary>PC specifications</summary>

- **CPU:** AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D
- **GPU:** NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090
- **RAM:** 64 GB (2×32 GB DDR5-6000 CL30)
- **SSD:** Solidigm P44 Pro 2 TB
- **OS:** Linux (Fedora 44)
</details>

Opening and closing the 3D platformer demo with shader cache emptied before every run (average of 20 runs):

```
$ hyperfine -iw1 -m20 -p "rm -rf ~/.local/share/godot/app_userdata/Platformer\ 3D/shader_cache/" "bin/godot.linu
xbsd.editor.x86_64 --path ~/d/3d/platformer --quit" "bin/godot.linuxbsd.editor.x86_64.master --path ~/d/3d/platformer --quit"
Benchmark 1: bin/godot.linuxbsd.editor.x86_64 --path ~/d/3d/platformer --quit
  Time (mean ± σ):      1.101 s ±  0.018 s    [User: 1.749 s, System: 0.581 s]
  Range (min … max):    1.075 s …  1.152 s    20 runs
 
Benchmark 2: bin/godot.linuxbsd.editor.x86_64.master --path ~/d/3d/platformer --quit
  Time (mean ± σ):      1.193 s ±  0.009 s    [User: 2.433 s, System: 0.579 s]
  Range (min … max):    1.177 s …  1.209 s    20 runs
 
Summary
  bin/godot.linuxbsd.editor.x86_64 --path ~/d/3d/platformer --quit ran
    1.08 ± 0.02 times faster than bin/godot.linuxbsd.editor.x86_64.master --path ~/d/3d/platformer --quit
```

For comparison, with a warm shader cache, it takes around 0.89 seconds.
Well, lets go ahead and merge. We can contribute this back upstream later
Looks good to me as well. The `result_id == 0` checks feel a bit redundant but IIRC that's never a valid result ID so I guess it's technically OK.
